name: Confirmation Parties 6
definition: Parties used for acting parties that apply either to the whole message or to individual sides.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that buys goods or services, or a financial instrument.

Borrower.name: Borrower
Borrower.definition: Party that has applied, met specific requirements, and received a monetary or securities loan from a lender. The party initiating the request signs a promissory note agreeing to pay the lien holder back during a specified timeframe for the entire loan amount plus any additional fees. The borrower is legally responsible for repayment of the loan and is subject to any penalties for not repaying the loan back based on the lending terms agreed upon.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that sells goods or services, or a financial instrument.

Lender.name: Lender
Lender.definition: A private, public or institutional entity which makes funds available to others to borrow.

BrokerOfCredit.name: Broker Of Credit
BrokerOfCredit.definition: Brokerage firm which is the commissioned broker in a multi-broker trade.

IntroducingFirm.name: Introducing Firm
IntroducingFirm.definition: Broker or other intermediary with the closest association with the investor.

StepInFirm.name: Step In Firm
StepInFirm.definition: Brokerage firm assigned to take credit on the trade from the step-out brokerage firm.

StepOutFirm.name: Step Out Firm
StepOutFirm.definition: Brokerage firm that executes an order, but gives other firms credit and some of the commission for the trade.

ClearingFirm.name: Clearing Firm
ClearingFirm.definition: Party, also know as take up broker, that settles security transactions from another broker for a fee.

ExecutingBroker.name: Executing Broker
ExecutingBroker.definition: Party responsible for executing an order (for example, an executing or give-up broker). Usually a commission is charged to the client for executing an order.

CMUParty.name: CMU Party
CMUParty.definition: Party sending the message to the CMU (Central Matching Utility) to identify the actual business unit as known to the CMU (Central Matching Utility).

CMUCounterparty.name: CMU Counterparty
CMUCounterparty.definition: Actual business unit of the counterparty to the sender of the message to the CMU (Central Matching Utility) as known to the CMU (Central Matching Utility).

AffirmingParty.name: Affirming Party
AffirmingParty.definition: Party (buyer or seller) that positively affirms the details of a previously agreed security trade confirmation.

TradeBeneficiaryParty.name: Trade Beneficiary Party
TradeBeneficiaryParty.definition: Party involved in a legal proceeding, agreement or other transaction.
